written_text_noun.source: INALI/Universidad Indígena de San Luis Potosí, glossary for Náhuatl de la Huasteca Potosina; PDF/printed35 and38
written_text_noun.primary_sense: At35 the text/words component of music contrasts with visual-art categories; the aligned Spanish continues on36. At38 writing requires knowledgeable readers. Together these support readable text, not a painting or song-only term. This is contextual interpretation, not a standalone TEXTO headword.

regional_mapping.finding: PDF1–2 maps Huasteca Potosina including Tamazunchale to nhw, and Huasteca Hidalguense including Xochiatipan to nch. This is not NHE lexical authority.

NT command/result spellings remain exactly as independently attested: NCH xijtali/quitalijtoc versus NHW xijtlali/quitlalijtoc. No c/k or t/tl harmonization is silently applied.
Both varieties independently attest xiquijcuilo. No command is generated by analogy from a third-person verb. The complete UI phrases are new functional compositions, not quoted GUI translations.

The result paraphrase explicitly retains clipboard as an English technical token naming the exact Android destination; it is neither a proposed native word nor an unattested copy-perfect. AN Paint is the named app subject.

included_row_findings.source_reading: OU p494 gives base, original without a POS label; OU p647 explicitly gives the noun size. The phrase is an authored nominal control label, not an attested complete sentence.
included_row_findings.caller_meaning: ClassicPaintActivity 758–759 calls restoreSelectionSize; PaintDocument 415–420 restores the retained selection bitmap width and height about the current center. The caller then fits the view. This is not a 100% viewport control, file-byte size, DPI change, rotation reset, or undo-all promise.
included_row_findings.limits: Original/base plus size is a bounded contextual composition. The source does not establish an adjective paradigm or all finite agreement, and none is claimed.

included_row_findings.source_reading: TBX share is a verb for making resources available to others; digital image is a singular noun. OU p616 saving and p151 done are the exact chosen forms. The adjacent saved/rescue-related family is not substituted, and the separate Save command is not mislabeled as a participle.
included_row_findings.caller_meaning: writeImage completes its stream copy before calling shareSavedImage. ClassicPaintActivity 1388 supplies this text to Intent.createChooser for ACTION_SEND with the saved image URI. The title identifies a saved object for prospective sharing, not completed sharing, automatic transmission, delivery, or receipt.
included_row_findings.limits: The parenthesized status qualifies the image and the saving operation. This is functional authored status composition, not a source-attested inflected phrase equivalent to saved image.

included_row_findings.backtranslation: Image: select (minimum: 1). In this checkbox context, image(s) is the intended counted category.
included_row_findings.source_reading: TBX select is explicitly a verb for marking items and adding checks to checkboxes. OU p454 minimum is exact, with no POS label supplied. TBX image is singular metadata, not a claimed plural-attested noun; contextual number is handled without invented morphology.
included_row_findings.caller_meaning: ImageCropDialog 145 rejects an empty selected set before applying crop; its checkbox subset may contain several images. ImageAssembly 155 rejects an empty ID set. Minimum 1 preserves any nonempty subset, rather than exactly one, a maximum, or image dimensions.
included_row_findings.limits: Nominal category plus action and numerical minimum is an authored UI instruction. No new plural finite verb or native-human grammatical certification is claimed.

included_row_findings.source_reading: OU p227 includes the exact first form in an adjective entry and a duplicate unqualified first entry. It is used as a separated step heading, not silently converted to an adjective describing which image. TBX tap is explicitly a verb for a brief fingertip or stylus press on a UI element.
included_row_findings.caller_meaning: AssemblyActivity 99–100 shows this when Unplace or Remove has no selected image. Board selection and thumbnail selection provide the prerequisite. It asks for a first action on an existing assembly image, not import, double-tap, or selecting the first image in list order.
included_row_findings.limits: Tap is retained as the exact UI action term, not a newly fabricated finite imperative. The punctuation carries the step-heading structure; the full sentence is not source-attested.

included_row_findings.source_reading: OU p647 explicitly supplies noun size; p421 supplies less, with no POS or complete comparative construction specified. OU p99 visually attests ᎭᏑᏯᎩ as the whole transitive command choose it (imperative), distinguishing the nearby choose him/her form. TBX independently attests the same choose form in a GUI-option sense.
included_row_findings.caller_meaning: AssemblyActivity 311 appends the warning to the current estimate when renderer.fits(sizing.dimensions) is false. DimensionControls exposes the current attempted geometric output dimensions; the creation button is disabled until a fitting size is chosen. The comparison anchor is that currently evaluated size.
included_row_findings.limits: The comparative less is explicitly scoped to size by the parenthesis, so it asks for a lesser size relative to the current unsuccessful attempt rather than an arbitrary absolute small category. It is prospective choice, not completed reduction. The complete comparative construction is authored, not attested; this contextual reading is the bounded acceptance basis.

additional_number_evidence.finding: Cherokee nouns are typically not separately pluralized; number can be expressed contextually or in verbs. This supports leaving the image noun unmodified with an attested plural adjective, without a claim that the TBX marks it plural or that this whole phrase is attested.

linguistic_findings.nch: Hernández Beatriz printed117 supplies tlajkuiloli explicitly as written text. Reopened hosted primary transcription and its authorship/locality introduction; no noun raster/PDF claimed. His Cruzhica, Xochiatipan locality maps regionally to nch in Valiñas. The separately read Central Huasteca corpus independently supplies exact xiquijcuilo, xijtali, quitalijtoc and ipan, including placement of readable inscription. Existing app ui_text was not evidence.
linguistic_findings.nhw: INALI Huasteca Potosina pages35–36 contrast music with and without text against visual-art categories; page38 describes difficult written material requiring knowledgeable readers. Both noun-page rasters, a newly rendered continuation36, and source title were read. This supports readable text contextually, not a standalone TEXTO headword. Western Huasteca corpus independently supplies xiquijcuilo, xijtlali, quitlalijtoc and ipan; its front matter names Tamazunchale and internal variation.
linguistic_findings.composition: All eight retain the independently attested whole noun tlajkuiloli. Both varieties independently attest the write imperative. Their place-command and result forms remain distinct. No silent c/k or t/tl normalization, other-variety transfer or app-label circular proof was used. Complete GUI utterances and digital application are authored functional compositions.
linguistic_findings.completed_result: Mark4:15 in each own corpus visibly attests its exact third-person placed-result form with an explicit agent, informational object and ipan destination. The clipboard rows intentionally describe the completed placing operation with AN Paint as agent, rather than claiming a source-attested copy-perfect.

caller_findings.ui_type_text: The single source reference is TextStyleDialog35, a multiline EditText hint. Write written text fits textual entry, including non-keyboard methods. It is neither freehand drawing nor immediate insertion.
caller_findings.ui_add_text: The single reference is the positive button at TextStyleDialog99. Validation produces TextSettings from the field, and the callback invokes PaintDocument.text at the chosen canvas coordinate. Nonblank text is drawn as glyphs into the bitmap. A place-written-text command fits this action without promising a file, clipboard paste, new layer or success.
caller_findings.ui_place_text: The single reference is the title at TextStyleDialog98 for that same configuration/insertion dialog. The canvas point is already supplied by PaintCanvas814 and ClassicPaintActivity201. Same wording as the positive button names the same operation, not a second gesture.
caller_findings.ui_full_text_copied: LegalInfo102 emits status only after system ClipboardManager.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText(title,text)) returns. The unchanged text parameter is the entire displayed dialog body at91. The title is clip label metadata, not additional body text. Full scope is the current about/asset/combined-notices body, not selected text, all app legal documents or the canvas. Explicit clipboard is a borrowed English technical token naming this destination. No save-file, permanence, future paste, cross-application availability or history guarantee is added.
